subject: Governance interlock / economic-buyer validation — Redwood pilot (Acme Retail)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme-retail.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Governance interlock / economic-buyer validation — Redwood pilot (Acme Retail)

Hi Priya / Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned before scheduling a broader governance/steering discussion: 

Attendees (call): Priya Sharma (Acme), Alex Johnson (Acme), Camila Reyes (Rwood AE), Marcus Lin (Rwood SE)

Key takeaways:
- Acme sees value in a short pilot to validate end-to-end latency and cost targets for the search/assist use case.
- Procurement + Legal want SOC 2 evidence and a data residency note; security has a few technical questions around KV cache retention.
- Economic buyer is the Head of Retail Ops (Priya to confirm name). Steering panel will include Procurement, Security, and one Exec Sponsor.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer (name + preferred email) and the executive sponsor who would attend the steering panel?
2) Procurement checklist we need to satisfy: SOC 2 summary, sample contract redline window, and billing/term expectations — attached SOC2 summary and SOW draft for review.
3) Proposed agenda for the steering/ops panel (30–45m): intro + success metrics, security/compliance Q&A, procurement timelines & acceptance criteria, pilot logistics and timeline.
4) Please share 2–3 windows next week (PST) that work for your exec sponsor and procurement lead. We can propose a calendar hold once we have a preferred slot.

I attached a light mutual action plan (MAP) and the SOW draft for procurement to skim — flagged items are areas we normally negotiate (data retention, SLAs, and escalation play).

If helpful I can loop in Ben from CS to talk about rollout and success metrics during the panel.

Thanks — looking to get the steering panel nailed down this week so we can start the pilot planning.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), redwood_sow_draft.pdf (application/pdf), soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme-retail.com>

Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Governance interlock / economic-buyer validation — Redwood pilot (Acme Retail)

Thanks Camila — good summary. Quick answers below: 

- Economic buyer: Meera Patel, Head of Retail Operations (meera.patel@acme-retail.com). She owns the pilot budget.
- Exec sponsor: Jordan Meyers, SVP Product (jordan.meyers@acme-retail.com) — likely to attend the steering panel for a 20–30m slot.
- Procurement: Primary contact is Alex Johnson (copied). Their checklist: SOC 2 summary (ok), PO terms (net30 preferred), and a standard indemnity clause review. We'll need the SOW and MAP redline window (legal can turn around in ~3 business days after doc review).
- Security: Please include our security lead Ravi Kumar (ravi.kumar@acme-retail.com) on the steering invite; he wants a short pre-read on cache retention and encryption-at-rest.

Suggested windows (all PST):
- Thurs 11/12, 10:00–10:45
- Fri 11/13, 13:00–13:45
- Mon 11/16, 09:30–10:00

We can confirm once you propose a calendar hold. I reviewed the SOW at a high level and will follow up with a prioritized list of redlines.

—Priya
Priya Sharma
Director, Retail Ops — Acme Retail
Priya.Sharma@acme-retail.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Governance interlock / economic-buyer validation — Redwood pilot (Acme Retail)

Camila / team — thanks. A couple of internal notes before we lock the panel: 

- Security prep: Neha, can you pull the SOC2 notes and a one-page technical summary on KV cache retention and encryption? Acme's Ravi will want specifics on TTLs and whether we persist any prefix keys off-host.
- SE ask: I'll prepare a 10-min performance readout (latency + token-cost estimate) scoped to the pilot dataset. Need the sample data shape — Priya/Alex, can you confirm an expected avg. query length and QPS target for the pilot?
- CS / Success: Ben, can you sketch a success metrics checklist (adoption thresholds, rollback criteria) so we can share on the steering call.

I'll also prepare a demo–light deck and include a short “what-we-need-from-procurement” slide that maps items in the MAP to contract items.

Thanks everyone — locking Thurs 11/12 10:00–10:45 PST per Priya's first option. Calendar invite with the proposed agenda and the MAP/SOW attached will be sent in a separate invite.

Pre-reads for the panel (attached):
- MAP (mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx) — sections highlighted for procurement redlines
- SOW draft (redwood_sow_draft.pdf) — request: legal to flag redlines in the PDF or via comments
- SOC2 summary (soc2-summary.pdf) — security may want deeper artifacts; Neha will follow up with links.

Camila (on behalf of Redwood) — we'll present: 1) pilot scope & success criteria, 2) short technical Q&A (Marcus), 3) procurement timeline & acceptance criteria (Ben).

Action items before the steering panel:
- Priya / Alex: confirm Meera and Jordan will attend (done) and Ravi will join for the security segment (Ravi copied).
- Neha: send the SOC2 supporting doc links and a 1-page technical note on retention.
- Marcus: finalize demo slides and pilot perf estimate.
- Ben: share a draft success metric checklist by EOD tomorrow.

Looking forward — Camila
